title: Add RAG agent tool-calling examples and docs update
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs updates: Python and TypeScript examples, notebook quickstart, and updated docs site entry.
body:
Motivation:
We want to provide example workflows for building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents that perform tool calling (search, SQL, webhook) using the Redwood SDKs. This PR adds opinionated templates and small quickstarts that demonstrate: 1) wiring a vector store, 2) implementing tool interfaces, 3) structured tool outputs, and 4) safe fallbacks when tools fail.

What this PR does (single-line description):
Adds RAG agent tool-calling examples (Python + TS), a Jupyter quickstart notebook, and documentation updates to the docs site with usage notes and a migration checklist.

Scope / Files included (high level):
- examples/rag-agent/python/quickstart.py - minimal RAG agent with two tools (search, exec) and sample prompts
- examples/rag-agent/typescript/quickstart.ts - TypeScript counterpart showing Redwood SDK usage and structured tool outputs
- examples/notebooks/rag-agent-quickstart.ipynb - walkthrough notebook (instructions + runnable cells)
- docs/site/docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-tool-calling.md - docs page with configuration and best practices
- mkdocs.yml - include new quickstart page in sidebar
- tests/examples/rag_agent_integration_test.py - lightweight smoke test using local vector store fixture

Checklist:
- [x] Examples compile and run locally (checked on macOS and linux CI containers)
- [x] Notebook renders in docs preview
- [x] Docs page added and linked in sidebar
- [x] Basic integration test added and passing in CI
- [x] Added short migration notes for existing RAG users

Notes on implementation choices:
- The examples intentionally keep the tool API surface small: tools implement a simple call(input, context) -> structured-output contract. This aligns with the SDK's tool-calling helpers and keeps the examples focused on wiring and failure handling instead of large tool implementations.
- The Python example uses our new "agent-runner" helper from redwood-sdk-python (no runtime changes required). The TS example mirrors the pattern and includes a sample of streaming tool outputs.

Related Linear/Jira: ENG-4321 (RAG agent examples), DOC-981 (docs), SUP-1142 (customer request for tool-calling samples).
